source.name: NASA POWER SMAP L4
source.description: SMAP L4 Global Daily Soil Moisture and Temperature at 9 km
source.note: SMAP L4 is a model-assimilated product combining SMAP observations with land surface model simulations. SFMC_PRCNTL is not available in this dataset, so only RZMC_PRCNTL and PRMC_PRCNTL are included.

SFMC.name: Surface Soil Moisture
SFMC.description: Volumetric soil moisture at 0-5 cm depth

RZMC.name: Root Zone Soil Moisture
RZMC.description: Volumetric soil moisture at 0-100 cm depth (root zone)
